basic_info.description: First Time on Market in 45 Years - Investor, Flipper, or DIY Dream! Located in the Excelsior District's popular Mission Terrace, this spacious 5 bed, 3 bath home offers approx. 2,337 sq ft of flexible living space and is priced among the lowest per square foot in the area.  Built in 1980, this home is ideal for multigenerational living, rental income, or remote work setups. The upper level features 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, a skylit living room with a white brick fireplace, and a kitchen with classic wood cabinets and gas cooktop. French doors open to a bonus space perfect for a playroom, art nook, or office. Downstairs offers 2 bedrooms, a full bath, and a large family room great for guests or multi-gen living. Laminate floors throughout, large windows, and a 2-car garage round out the home. Perfect for investors looking for value, flippers ready to renovate, or homeowners who love DIY projects and want to make it their own. Enjoy an end-of-street location near Balboa Park's tennis courts, pool, skatepark, and more. Close to BART, Muni, freeways, and local cafe and shops. Come see it today!
